messages.content: The gallery changed Friday again. Final lighting now runs through 6:00, and the lender sign-off is scheduled immediately afterward. I cannot make the 7:20 flight. Please compare the later Friday connection with the Saturday nonstop, including the real sign-off margin, arrival time, fare difference, and another night at the Hampton. Do not change anything yet because I need authorization.

I’ll price both alternatives against ticket H7Q4LM and check the Hampton extension separately. What time does the gallery expect the lender sign-off to finish, and will your suitcase still be stored at the hotel?
They are calling 6:30 the target and 7:00 the outside estimate. The suitcase can stay at the Hampton, so I still have to go there before the airport.

With a 6:30 release, the 8:36 p.m. one-stop is possible but tight. Allowing about 10 minutes to the Hampton, 10 to 15 minutes for retrieval, and 15 minutes to PVD puts you at the airport around 7:10 to 7:20, only 76 to 86 minutes before departure. A 7:00 release would put arrival closer to 7:40 to 7:50, leaving 46 to 56 minutes, which is not a sound plan with a checked bag. I’m checking the exact connection, current fare, change rules, and Saturday inventory now.
Please also tell me whether a delay on the first segment would leave any protection. I do not want to pay more for Friday and then be stranded midway.

The Friday option is Delta 5321 from Providence at 8:36 p.m. to New York-LaGuardia, connecting to Delta 1487 for Atlanta. Scheduled arrival is 12:47 a.m. Saturday. The connection at LaGuardia is 58 minutes. Because both segments would be on one Delta ticket, Delta would rebook you after an airline-controlled or operational misconnection, but the remaining late-night alternatives are limited; a substantial delay could mean an overnight in New York. Hotel coverage would depend on the cause of the disruption.
And the Saturday nonstop?

Delta 2174 departs Providence Saturday at 9:05 a.m. and arrives Atlanta at 11:36 a.m. It is nonstop. With a normal trip from the Hampton to PVD, leaving the hotel around 7:00 provides a comfortable airport margin, and Friday’s sign-off can run late without affecting the flight.
What are the numbers compared with what I already paid? Include taxes for the room.

Changing only the return to the Friday connection raises the ticket total by $184.20, so that amount would be collected at exchange. The Saturday nonstop raises it by $96.40. The Hampton can extend the same reservation through Saturday for $318.00 plus $43.47 in taxes, or $361.47 total. That makes the incremental trip cost $184.20 for Friday versus $457.87 for Saturday flight and hotel combined, before meals or ground transportation.
So Saturday costs $273.67 more overall, but Friday depends on a 6:30 release and a short connection.

Correct. The Friday plan saves $273.67, but it has two separate pressure points: reaching PVD in time to check the bag and making the 58-minute LaGuardia connection. Saturday costs more and gets you home nearly eleven hours later, but it removes both Friday-evening risks.

If both were genuinely workable, I would choose the later Friday departure and get home that night. Here, though, I need you to judge whether 6:30 is enough or whether the outside estimate makes Saturday the responsible request.

At 6:30, Friday is workable only if sign-off ends on time, the hotel handoff is immediate, and traffic stays ordinary. There is little recovery room if any step slips. Since the gallery itself gives 7:00 as the outside estimate, I would request authorization for Saturday as the operationally defensible option. The extra cost buys certainty that the required sign-off, rather than the flight clock, controls your departure from the gallery.
Verify the ticket rules. This is standard economy, not basic. Can they charge a change fee in addition to the fare difference, and what happens if I wait until tomorrow?

I verified the fare conditions on H7Q4LM. It is Main Cabin standard economy. Delta lists no change fee for this domestic itinerary; you pay only the applicable fare difference when the ticket is reissued. The original ticket value remains applied to the new itinerary. If you wait, the ticket remains changeable before the scheduled 7:20 p.m. Friday departure, but neither quoted fare is guaranteed and inventory could disappear. Missing the original flight without changing or canceling first could forfeit the remaining value.
Does moving to Saturday count as same-day standby or require a normal exchange?

It requires a normal voluntary exchange because the new departure is on the following calendar day. Same-day confirmed change or standby does not apply. The current Saturday fare difference is the full $96.40 quoted for reissue; there is no separate same-day fee.
Now verify the Hampton terms. I need to know whether the extension can be canceled independently if the gallery releases us early enough for Friday after all.

The Hampton confirmed that the added Friday night can be attached to confirmation PVD62841 while keeping you in the same room. The extension is a separate flexible-night charge of $361.47. It can be canceled without penalty until 6:00 p.m. Eastern on Thursday, June 17. After that, canceling the added night incurs the full one-night charge. Canceling only the extension does not cancel the existing June 16-18 stay.
Is there any early-departure charge or problem if they attach it now and I later remove it before that deadline?

No. The hotel stated there is no early-departure fee if the extension is removed by 6:00 p.m. on June 17. They would restore the checkout date to Friday, June 18, and the original reservation terms and luggage-storage note would remain intact. After the deadline, the added night becomes nonrefundable even if you check out Friday.
Can you hold both flight choices and the room while I send this to finance? I expect an answer this afternoon.

The airline will not place both alternatives on a guaranteed hold without exchanging the ticket. I can retain the live quotes in the trip record, but price and seats remain subject to change. The Hampton has placed a courtesy hold on the Friday-night extension at $361.47 until 5:00 p.m. Eastern today; it is not yet added to PVD62841 and no charge has been made.
Then keep the hotel hold and leave the flight alone. Give me a compact authorization comparison I can forward, and state the latest point when Friday is still credible.

Authorization comparison: Option 1 changes the return to the Friday 8:36 p.m. Providence-LaGuardia-Atlanta itinerary, arriving 12:47 a.m., with a 58-minute connection and a $184.20 ticket increase. It is credible only with a firm gallery release by about 6:30 p.m.; a 7:00 release leaves inadequate checked-bag margin and makes the option imprudent. Option 2 changes the return to the Saturday 9:05 a.m. nonstop, arriving 11:36 a.m., with a $96.40 ticket increase, plus $361.47 for the hotel extension, for $457.87 incremental cost. It accommodates the full sign-off window and avoids connection risk. Delta charges no change fee, but fares are not held. The Hampton extension is on courtesy hold until 5:00 p.m. Eastern today and would remain cancelable without penalty through 6:00 p.m. Eastern June 17 once added. No flight or hotel reservation has been changed.
